evidence_quotes.agenda: Never asked — call is an online-booking confirmation, no discovery script used.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concern was ever raised anywhere in the call — no-concern fix applied.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'Our movers are not daily contracted workers. They are the most well vetted and professionally trained movers in the industry' and 'once we go over that minimum the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments.'

top_strength: Thorough, efficient logistics intake (elevator access, hallway distance, TV sizes/boxes already on hand) that gave a genuinely complete picture for the move.
coaching_note: The estimate range (4h45m) was simply confirmed as accurate rather than personalized to a specific detail already on the call (elevator access, short 20-30 ft hallway) — tying the range explicitly to those details would make the number feel earned rather than just repeated from the system.
grading_notes: Judgment call: stage3_close scored full credit (5) since this is an online-booking confirmation call with no natural rate-lock/explicit-ask moment (customer already committed by booking online).
